## Berlin, day 3

Writing on the ICE 140 back, Berlin Hbf 14:49, should be home 21:15. Two days at Lagerhaus Spree with Jens. Ute walked us through all 22 doors at 06:00 on Wednesday, minus 2 degrees, trucks already queued to the roundabout. I counted 17 waiting. Status report draft in [[Projektstatus Berlin]].

## Fasting while travelling

Day 14 of Ramadan. Hardest part was the hotel: breakfast buffet at 06:30, everyone eating, me with my water at 05:15 in the room. Iftar on Wednesday with Jens at a Turkish place in Kreuzberg (Hasir), he fasted with me for the day out of solidarity, lasted till 15:00. Sweet man. Longer entries in Arabic in [[يوميات رمضان]].

## Trains

Train both ways because of the [[Expense policy]], and honestly I prefer it. Looked at whether a pass makes sense for the Berlin trips this year (5 or 6 planned), notes in [[Rail pass Europe]]. Single fare was €109 out, €89 back with the Sparpreis.

## Mood

Tired but proud. Ute laughed at one of my jokes in German. That's a first.
